page.layout: One printed page, title page: all lines centred in one block, from top to bottom. No margins with text. A metal library fastener at the foot is not printed text.
page.notes: Title page in mixed display types: the first line is in large italic capitals, the second is an ampersand, the third is in italic lowercase with a large swash initial and cut off at the right edge (the final word "Christi" is partly clipped by the scan edge). "PATER" is in large roman capitals. The fifth and sixth lines are in italic. The line "Consolationis." ends with a period. No page number, running head or signature is printed.
